summary: Switched extract artifact writes to append-safe NDJSON with a versioned schema and added task metadata (task string, task_id) plus run_id and timestamp. Updated notes and task status, and adjusted tests accordingly.
notes: Extract artifacts are now one JSON record per run (newline-delimited), with schema_version=1, run_id derived from task_id+timestamp, and task metadata fields. See `src/output.rs` and `src/main.rs`. Notes added at `notes/2026-02-11-extract-002-append-schema.md` and indexed in `notes/index.md`. Task marked completed in `prd.json`.
